about: Hero props (asset round 3). Tripo text-to-3D, standard, PBR (albedo, metallic-roughness, normal), 5 credits each. Each was turned -90 degrees about Y so its front faces +Z, put on the ground (lowest vertex at y=0, centred in x/z), scaled to a real-world height, and re-exported as one mesh with embedded 1024 px textures (normalize_glb.gd, a GLTFDocument variant of game/tools/normalize_part.gd). Texture imports must be Lossy (WebP), never VRAM. contact_sheet.jpg shows each from +Z (front), +X, -Z and -X, rendered in Godot 4.3 Compatibility.
